items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Dicky' appears only in the interviewer's prose summary/context block, not in the interviewee's spoken response. The interviewee does not mention Dicky or describe any interaction.

ctx.x: Did jam sessions have much to do with the development of Bebop.

Minton's playhouse was the place... The place was Minton's -- Minton's Playhouse, that originally, the Modern jazz got started. The other places, they were open but they didn't accept it. There wasn't that type of musician down there in the first place. So if one or two of em came they would be out of place... Minton's was the place where that type of place person would meet... (I could tap dance with the best of em)... It was an unwritten law, they just kept away from each other... Dicky
